<!-- A test file is vetted through `filename=…_test.go`; `template="test"` adds the package clause from `module=`, `goimports` the imports. `t.Fatal` from a goroutine is a vet finding. -->

```{.go .run .vet .output .expect-failure template="test" module="example.com/board" filename="board_test.go"}
func TestBoard(t *testing.T) {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		t.Fatal("from a goroutine")
	}()
	<-done
}
```
